### SPEC §7 module row

### SPEC §9 sentence

### docs/stdlib.md section

## `std/mutmap`

Source: [`mutmap/mutmap.gt`](../std/mutmap/mutmap.gt). 10 top-level declarations.

`MutMap[K, V]` is an opaque handle with no standard class instances. All operations are deferred IO. The map retains its creation-time Ord witness; native prelude Int/String order is specialized, and custom Ord dictionaries retain their order. Each operation holds a per-map mutex; lookup followed by insert is not an atomic read-modify-write. Comparison functions must be pure total orders and must not re-enter the handle. Cancellation is checked before and after locking and before mutation commits; comparator panic or cancellation before commit preserves the old tree. A mutex wait does not interrupt an operation already holding the lock. Snapshots copy the tree/list structure, not the key/value payloads.

| Source signature | Semantics | Boundary behaviour | Law-eligible |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `func new[K Ord, V]() IO[MutMap[K, V]]` | Create an empty ordered map. | Each execution allocates a fresh handle. | No |
| `extern func insert[K Ord, V](m MutMap[K, V], k K, v V) IO[Unit]` | Insert or replace in O(log n). | An Ord-equivalent key is replaced by the new key/value; size is unchanged on replacement. | No |
| `extern func lookup[K Ord, V](m MutMap[K, V], k K) IO[Option[V]]` | Search in O(log n). | Some(value) when present, None otherwise. Tree traversal allocates nothing; ordinary IO/Option wrapper costs remain. | No |
| `extern func delete[K Ord, V](m MutMap[K, V], k K) IO[Unit]` | Remove a key in O(log n). | Missing keys are a no-op. | No |
| `extern func size[K, V](m MutMap[K, V]) IO[Int]` | Read the entry count in O(1). | Empty map returns zero; no Ord constraint is needed. | No |
| `extern func toList[K Ord, V](m MutMap[K, V]) IO[List[(K, V)]]` | Copy an ascending snapshot in O(n). | Empty map returns Nil; later updates cannot change the snapshot's bindings. | No |
| `extern func freeze[K Ord, V](m MutMap[K, V]) IO[Map[K, V]]` | Copy into an ordinary persistent Map in O(n). | Later handle updates cannot change the pure Map's bindings. | No |
| `func thaw[K Ord, V](m Map[K, V]) IO[MutMap[K, V]]` | Copy bindings into a fresh mutable map in O(n log n). | Uses the supplied Ord even if the source was made with an explicit By comparator; does not modify the source. | No |
| `extern func newBy[K, V](cmp func(K, K) Ordering) IO[MutMap[K, V]]` | Low-level constructor with an explicit retained comparator. | Same fresh-handle and IO contract as new; use that total order for any frozen Map's By operations. | No |
| `extern func thawBy[K, V](m Map[K, V], cmp func(K, K) Ordering) IO[MutMap[K, V]]` | Low-level thaw with an explicit retained comparator. | Fresh handle on each execution; source remains unchanged. | No |
